meta.title: Extend the live Technical stage to 10 minutes after the current end
gaps: Verify that vendors' countdowns show exactly 10 additional minutes and that vendors can still bid until the extended deadline.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that vendors' countdowns show exactly 10 additional minutes and that vendors can still bid until the extended deadline.

plan.title: Extend Live Technical Stage by 10 Minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ project without recreating or searching for it.
Navigate to the live Technical stage whose submission time must be extended.
Set the Technical stage end time to 10 minutes after its current end and verify that Procol saves the extension.
Open the Technical stage's activity drawer to inspect the audit record.
Verify that the Order Activity drawer opened.
Verify that the activity drawer contains an entry for the submission-time extension.
